newsitem.title: USA: Syntellect Inc expects to post Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Syntellect Inc expects to post Q3 loss.

text.p: Syntellect Inc said on Monday its preliminary third-quarter results showed the company lost between $1 million and $1.5 million, or $0.07 to $0.11 per share, during the period.
In the third quarter of 1995, the company lost $1.1 million, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $14.4 million.
The company said it expects to post revenues for this year's third quarter of between $12 million and $12.5 million.
The final results are expected to be released on October 24.
Syntellect attributed part of the reason for the loss to underperforming markets in the Far East and Latin America.
Chairman and Chief Executive Larry Bradner said in a statement that he does not expect that situation to change "materially in the near future."
